items.title: 《全面战争：战锤 40,000》的星际战士必须让帝国满意，并避免显得过于异端
items.summary: Even genetically augmented super soldiers need to worry about their rep.

content.v: One of the significant differences between most historical Total Wars and the Warhammer games is that the factions aren't comparable with nations. In Total War: Warhammer 40,000, the Space Marines and Astra Militarum, for instance, are effectively two branches of the same military.

So when I was playing Total War 40k at Gamescom as the Ultramarines, I noticed that my settlement garrison was full of just ordinary soldiers—members of the Planetary Defense Force. These units only served to defend the settlement, like a normal Total War garrison, but they weren't the same units that I could recruit as a Space Marine faction.

"The way that the Imperium works together is going to be very important," Dave Petry, battle product owner, told me. "And working as a Space Marine with local planetary forces and governors to be able to get the support that you need in order to be able to be that tip of the spear, we want that to be the case."

How the Imperium works, and your relationship to it, is still a work in progress, but Petry added that Creative Assembly has been playing around with concepts like "gaining support to be able to bring along units with you to fight your battles". So we might be able to bring in some meat shields from the PDF, or units from the Astra Militarum, to fight alongside our Space Marines.

I already saw a hint of this in the demo I played. In both the medium and massive-sized battles, my Space Marines arrived to find the Astra Militarum already fighting orks. I wasn't able to control them—they were just an allied force—but hopefully this is just a taste of something meatier.

Petry also teased what sounds like a reputation system. "Collaborating among the Imperium is something we really want to be able to do, and managing your reputation in the Imperium as a Space Marine is also something that's very important. Like not doing things that look too much like building an empire or becoming too powerful." So you'll need to keep the Imperium happy and avoid being accused of heresy.

Creative Assembly wants to "fill the galaxy out," says Petry, so we can expect to see other elements of the Imperium appearing. I'm really keeping my fingers crossed for some Adeptus Mechanicus fun in the near future. And the studio has already been teasing other Space Marine chapters, like my beloved Space Wolves, as well as xenos threats like Genestealer cults.

The good news is that you won't need to buy three games to see it all this time. Unlike Total War: Warhammer, Total War 40k is going to be a sandbox that Creative Assembly keeps adding to , rather than a series of separate games.

马里奥赛车8豪华版 新增八人分屏模式

content.v: Mario Kart 8 Deluxe has been Nintendo's golden goose for several years, as it's the company's best-selling Switch game of all time and has received various updates over the years, becoming a feature-packed experience. Even with Mario Kart World aiming to usurp its position, Nintendo isn't done dropping new content into Mario Kart 8 yet, as the game just received a new eight-player split-screen mode out of nowhere on Switch 2. It's free to download, allows for up to eight players to share the screen locally, and it looks wild in action.

Alongside the new mode that segments your TV like a slab of chocolate, Mario Kart 8 Deluxe Version 4.0.0 also adds several more improvements that take advantage of the increased horsepower on Switch 2. In a nutshell, you're getting sharper graphics, CameraPlay support, and shorter load times in addition to smaller quality-of-life tweaks under the hood of the popular kart-racing game. Even player speed has been increased by a whopping coin--whatever that means.

But the expanded local split-screen is the real star of the show here, as not only can you strain your eyes while playing on TV, but you can also make your local optometrist happy by watching all those races unfold in handheld mode on the Switch 2. Considering just how much of an intensive load it is to render eight sessions in real time, the new multiplayer mode is a technical marvel to watch.

This will likely keep Mario Kart 8 Deluxe at the top of the Nintendo food chain for a while yet. Mario Kart World has its charm, but as fans have pointed out, the anemic amount of content added since its launch last year has made it hard to root for. That drought might be coming to a temporary end, as with a rumored Nintendo Direct supposedly arriving later this month, players are expecting Mario Kart World to get some sort of an update. If you're looking to grab it, a new Switch 2 + Mario Kart World bundle ($550) launches in late September--albeit for $50 when compared to the original launch bundle.

items.title: 《苍穹浩瀚：奥西里斯重生》将最好的《质量效应》任务变成了一个完整的游戏
items.summary: And makes it better.

content.v: I played an hour of The Expanse: Osiris Reborn at Gamescom, and despite doing it in a sweltering room with a dev judging me for every death, I came away pretty impressed. It deserves to stand on its own merits, but unfortunately I am about to talk about Mass Effect quite a lot—it's hard not to.

Like the BioWare of old, Owlcat is an isometric CRPG developer now trying its hand at a cinematic third-person RPG, which turns into a cover-heavy squad-based shooter when the guns come out. Mass Effect, then, is an obvious point of comparison.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/xBeXUgSHeLAfeDXZffFzFC.jpg

But it's a comparison that serves The Expanse well, because in the short time I played it, I saw a multitude of ways in which it has improved upon BioWare's formula. How it handles exploration, combat and crew interactions makes me think, if it can keep it up, that The Expanse is going to make Mass Effect diehards extremely happy, without leaving Owlcat's CRPG fans out in the cold.

We already wrote about The Expanse's hi-tech fights after checking it out in April. "I was worried Owlcat couldn't pull off Mass Effect-style cinematic action in its big new RPG, but after an hour of blowing stuff up in The Expanse: Osiris Reborn, I'm feeling very reassured," Robin said back then. And I'm feeling the same way.

Mass Effect took three games to get its shooting up to snuff, but The Expanse might have nailed it on the first go. It's more responsive, varied, and you can order your teammates to pull off some explosively neat tricks. They're called exploits, and depending on who you have in your three-person squad, you'll see different parts of the environment highlighted in red—these are places where your pals can do their thing.
Double trouble
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/gQjPAD9fcywb2ZFsyBevg.jpg

J, my identical twin who serves as the first companion, seems to mostly enjoy blowing things up. Usually that means cover. I was fighting Protogen goons—the villainous Earth corporation—and took every opportunity to stop them from cowardly hiding behind walls. But I also used J to take out bridges, a lift and other objects, with each instance rewarding me with a spectacular explosion and some dead foes.
A quick stun, a bullet in the head, job done.
Another companion sows chaos with their technical knowledge. If there are wires running underneath the floor in a combat area, they can electrify the floor and swiftly take out a bunch of enemies.

Not that I needed any help electrocuting people. I was playing as the engineer class, which allowed me to deploy turrets and drones. Midway through the demo, I got access to a new type of drone that could stun foes, which was a real game-changer when I started encountering dudes with flamethrowers that seemed to ignore cover. A quick stun, a bullet in the head, job done.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/8PwYwjd23KgnpFkFPTFpFC.jpg

Unlike the previous demo, though, my Gamescom playthrough gave me lots of time for chatting and exploration. My twin and I were infiltrating a Protogen facility, disguised as employees of the titular Osiris organisation, so we didn't need to go in guns blazing.

The Expanse will see you putting together a crew for a heist, much in the same way Shep put one together for the suicide mission in Mass Effect 2. But even before you get to the actual heist, there are lots of smaller crimes and thematically adjacent missions that have the same heist energy.

I'm reminded of my favourite Mass Effect 2 loyalty mission, where you recruit Kasumi by helping her with a robbery. There are disguises, there's subterfuge, there's a lot of sticking it to rich dorks—it's a whole heap of fun. But that seems to just be a normal day in The Expanse, which is a thrilling prospect.
Team building
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/GrRJZiwJDipDFPrGLUdVnB.jpg

Anyway! Back to the infiltration. I was able to talk my way through most encounters with Protogen losers, and while The Expanse doesn't have the density of text or varied dialogue options of, say, Owlcat's Rogue Trader, I still felt able to make meaningful decisions and find different routes past obstacles.

When I needed to get into a crate, for instance, I failed to persuade a Protogen employee that it didn't matter that I had no paperwork. My persuasion skill wasn't high enough. But I was able to download some documents from a terminal, which one of my pals onboard my ship used to create a forgery.

This is possibly my favourite feature—that you have access to all these specialists who can lend you their expertise when you're off gallivanting on another mission. Interjections and offers of assistance seem common, too, making it feel like you're part of a proper heist crew. And sometimes it's just flavourful banter, allowing you to get a clearer picture of who these characters are, without you needing to walk up to them and have a full conversation.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/vVo7yK6CtoCEMvR2R5rKn.jpg

Sometimes they'll have requests too, asking you to check something out that they've spotted on your feed. It's a level of teamwork that I haven't really seen represented in an RPG before, and one that gives your NPC pals a convincing illusion of agency.

Now I wish some of this stuff could have been in Mass Effect. You've got this crewed up ship, and that's cool, but outside of the companions you take with you on missions, the crew is barely even ancillary. Yes, you can date Kelly Chambers, and occasionally you'll hear from Joker or pre-android EDI when you're on a mission, but their participation is minimal. It's the same with your companions who you leave behind—they might as well not exist unless you're standing right next to them.

The Expanse, meanwhile, makes your companions just as critical to the mission as you, even when they're not with you in person. They are the solutions to your problems, they come up with plans, and they can even give you hints about how to take down a difficult enemy. By the end of the demo, I'd only met a couple of them in person, but I was already a fan of the whole bunch.
Spacecation
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/woJasyVMtV74NaNj5LYWyB.jpg

I really dug the quieter moments, too. At one point, we had to sneak through Ganymede's original colony, an underground warren that was constructed before the domes. Suddenly we'd gone from a corporate sci-fi thriller into something more horror-themed, slinking through dark, dilapidated ruins. It felt haunted.
I really dug the quieter moments, too.

Similarly, I enjoyed just wandering around the Protogen facility, when they still thought I was an ally. There's plenty of environmental storytelling and NPCs getting on with their day or having chats. With only an hour to spare, however, I had to start rushing through it, but I encountered quite a few diversions, locked doors and points of interest that I would have otherwise been keen to dive into.

If you've watched the show or read the books, you'll be rewarded for your foreknowledge with plenty of little nods here and there—especially when you're snooping around and reading everyone's emails. But if this is all new to you, it'll just appear to be worldbuilding rather than gatekeeping.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/zSfTpQerUHzim8gYsRbfnB.jpg

The demo ended on a cliffhanger, with my squad ready to pull off an audacious plan to stop a protomolecule mutant from doing more damage. I was ready to get stuck in, and then the "Thanks for playing" message appeared. It was devastating. I had to rush to another appointment anyway, but if Owlcat said "Nah, it's cool, you can play more," I don't think I would have been able to decline.

items.title: SteamDB 转手为 Nexus Mods，这意味着它现在“需要赚钱”——但不会有广告或付费墙
items.summary: "Nothing you know and use today is getting taken away and sold back to you."

content.v: SteamDB is an excellent resource—as someone who occasionally has to pull up a game's concurrent numbers or pricing to make a point, I'd be lying if I said I haven't used it in a professional capacity. What's been more staggering is its status as a site run entirely on donations.

Well, that's ending soon. The site's founder, xPaw, has decided to move on due to a feeling of burnout. In their full statement , they write: "After Covid and with the rise of AI, the internet we once loved is gone, and with it my passion. I have started experiencing burnout with the project, but I powered through.

"A few years ago I tried to find someone to continue the project, but I couldn't find a team that I was confident in, so I decided to keep going by myself. Steam keeps growing, in terms of games, players, and the number of new features being added. It's hard to keep on top of this alone, and the mental load has only kept increasing, and in good conscience I cannot continue like this."

The buyers in question? NexusMods, which has its own sister announcement on its site that details its motivations, which are twofold. Firstly, having the information SteamDB has collated over the years is useful: "We have already started collecting Steam game data ourselves, but once an update is pushed, manifests and data for the old versions become much more difficult to access. SteamDB already does this far better than we can, and has a massive back-catalogue to draw from."

Another, the site says, is the fact that SteamDB's database can help its mod manager "better understand which version of the game you’re running, whether mods you’re installing were built for it, and whether an incoming game update is likely to cause issues.

"It could also make it possible for Collections and other mod lists to better specify the exact version of a game they were built for, rather than relying on someone finding that information buried in a description, comment, or forum post."

That's all in the future, though—one that looks good for xPaw, who will no longer be forced to shoulder the burden of running SteamDB on their own, but perhaps a big question mark for folks who actually use SteamDB. Primarily because it was a donation-fed project, and thus immune to the kind of unpleasantness that comes with sites that need to turn a profit.

In a FAQ , NexusMods cops to this being a consideration going forward: "We're going to be straight about this rather than dance around it: yes, SteamDB needs to make money. What xPaw has built—and kept running largely through personal dedication and community donations—is an extraordinary achievement.
"Giving it the team, infrastructure and long-term investment it deserves is how we protect that work and ensure SteamDB can thrive for the next decade and beyond."

That doesn't mean you're going to be flooded with ads, though, at least, that's the plan: "No. We don't have plans to introduce display or programmatic advertising on SteamDB. Over time, we may explore things like affiliate links and partnerships where they genuinely provide value to the user." Nexus Mods also plans to keep the site free: "nothing you know and use today is getting taken away and sold back to you."

Either way, it's the end of an era—the turning of a great free resource into one that, as Nexus Mods states, does need to make money now. xPaw says they have "full confidence the team will be able to continue improving the project for gamers, developers and publishers alike."

items.title: 屡获殊荣的主持人 Frankie Ward 正在主持 PC Gaming Show Tokyo Direct，展示超过 35 款游戏和一系列全球首发游戏
items.summary: Summer may be ending, but we're still bringing the heat.

content.v: The PC Gaming Show Tokyo Direct is back September 20 , and PC Gamer is happy to announce the fantastic Frankie Ward will be hosting, making it her second PC Gaming Show of the year.
Frankie is a host and presenter with years of experience. She won presenter of the year at the 2018 inaugural UK Esports Awards, and she's hosted our own shows more times than I can count.

"We've got a seriously stacked show for you—lots of world premieres, brand-new trailers, reports direct from Tokyo Game Show and a whole load of exclusive treats in store," Frankie says. "Join me on September 20 as we dive into it all!"

The reports from the show floor will be coming from PC Gamer's Wesley Fenlon, who will be in Tokyo interviewing developers at their booths. As well as boots on the ground journalism, you can expect new trailers from over 35 games, including Stronghold 4 —which we announced during the June show—and Virtue and a Sledgehammer , which just looks divine. What's not to love about smashing up the robots invading your hometown while you also relive traumatic memories?

If all that isn't enough, we'll also be bringing you a deep dive on Tenebris Somnia, a retro survival horror adventure with live-action cutscenes, plus a bunch more super secret stuff I can't share with you just yet. Luckily you've only got a few weeks to wait.

Tune into the show on X, Steam, YouTube, Twitch, Facebook—basically anywhere you can host a video— Sunday, September 20, at 5 pm BST, 12 pm EDT, 9 am PDT. If you're a streamer who wants to get in on the action and co-stream the show, you can fill in this form .
If you want a refresher on some of the bangers we revealed back in June, check out our everything announced article .

items.summary: Last week, we announced our plans to kick off our Anti-Cheat Trials initiative, and today it's here! Starting

content.v: Last week, we announced our plans to kick off our Anti-Cheat Trials initiative, and today it's here!

Starting today, we will be trialing Denuvo's Anti-Cheat solution. Note that this does not and will not include anything related to DRM, as Denuvo Anti-Cheat is different from Denuvo Anti-Piracy. Another look at the difference between the two:
What we ARE trialing: Denuvo Anti-Cheat
A tool that detects cheats in-game, identifying people who try to get unfair advantages before they can disrupt fair play
What we ARE NOT trialing: Denuvo Anti-Piracy
Tools that prevent the cracking and unauthorized access of game content
In case you missed it, here's what you can expect:
Anti-Cheat Trials are exclusive to Steam and cross-play will not be impacted.

We’re continuously testing the compatibility and performance of each anti-cheat provider to ensure you have a seamless experience. Compatibility with Steam Deck and Proton has been tested and will continue to be supported.
The first time you launch the game during the Anti-Cheat Trial, you will be prompted to install Denuvo Anti-Cheat. This is required to play the game.

Please continue to use the in-game report function as normal to report any cheaters you encounter. Detailed comments about what you see (i.e. wallhacks, speedhacks, teleporting) are greatly appreciated; the more context, the better.
Note: Selecting the “Hacking/Exploiting” category when submitting a report covers everything from cheaters to hackers.
At the end of this Anti-Cheat Trial, Denuvo Anti-Cheat will be automatically deactivated in Dead by Daylight and will no longer run on your system.
A step-by-step guide on how to clean up any remaining Denuvo Anti-Cheat files has been added to our Support Portal should you need it: Denuvo Anti-Cheat FAQ – Dead by Daylight
Let us know if you have any feedback about the anti-cheat provider being tested in our dedicated Discord channel, which will also go live today.

What do we expect from you? Simple. Play the game as you normally would, report any cheaters you encounter through the in-game reporting system, and let us know your thoughts on this anti-cheat provider!
We want to reiterate that your feedback is incredibly valuable to us and we'd love to have it every step of the way.
Until next time…
The Dead by Daylight Team

content.v: And what we can do about it when we spot it.

Breath of the Wild was one of my first video games after an unintentional gaming hiatus (#adulting, sigh). I was good at it—some of it, at least, things like exploring the map, completing side quests, and flurry rushing enemies. But getting the bonus treasure chest in Ree Dahee Shrine? I couldn’t figure it out.

This was made infinitely worse by the fact that I could see the treasure chest, hopelessly above me, taunting me. Items, runes, armour, food buffs, jumping—nothing worked. This was a game for children, and I, an adult, was stumped. I was embarrassed, doubly so when I eventually looked up the solution.

items.title: 战锤西格玛时代：死亡大师的玩法有点像隐秘的空洞骑士IGN 预览
items.summary: I had a maniacally delightful time with the very small slice of Warhammer Age of Sigmar: Deathmaster I got to

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/01/wh40kasd-blogroll-1788297865199.jpg
Key Preview Takeaways:

It's rare that the giant, horrible rat men of the Skaven get a starring role in a Warhammer game, despite being one of the most unique and popular factions. They're normally the fodder you chew through in a horde game like Vermintide. So Warhammer Age of Sigmar: Deathmaster immediately sets itself apart by putting you in the stinking rags of Vihneek, a resourceful rodent we're introduced to as he's being unceremoniously dumped into a festering pit full of corpses. You know, it's probably not how he planned to spend his day. But rising from his unfortunate circumstances, he quickly takes to sneaking and murder in the spirit of his backstabbing lineage across a variety of gloomy, vermin-filled 2D sidescrolling environments that provided a good variety of challenges even in this short demo.
Gnaw-low Knight

Vihneek's starting surroundings are gory, putrid, and almost hopeless. Which is to say, absolutely perfect for a game starring the Skaven, with layered caverns stretching off into the background and every crevice and torn canvas painted with a gloomy malice. I'm not a huge expert on Age of Sigmar lore, but coming from a Warhammer Fantasy background, I wouldn't have necessarily been able to tell this was a different setting. The Skaven are still quite recognizably Skaven, in all their duplicitous glory, doing Skaven things like sneaking and scheming through an underground world ruled over by many clans who often engage in bitter rivalries.

I started out almost completely powerless, with my grubby little paws bound in wooden stocks and only able to slowly waddle in either direction. But upon freeing myself with a bit of percussive problem-solving, I found Vihneek to be an agile little scamp who is quite enjoyable to control across a variety of platforming challenges. Notably, you can run along most walls and ceilings, which immediately sells the idea of playing as a Skaven and makes movement feel quite a bit different from similar side-scrollers. The animations that bring this to life are spot-on as well. Vihneek is just a weird little guy, and I support him.

For the first little bit after this sneaky escape, mobility and stealth were my only tools. It was still unclear how I got here, but the twisting nooks that stretched out in every direction seemed to be some sort of prison. Coming into close contact with any of the armed guards means instant death and restarting at the place I entered the current chamber, and these jailers can also throw shockingly accurate projectiles to get you down from a high perch if they spot you.

Hiding behind drapes, extinguishing lights, and tossing abandoned skulls as distractions are among the many ways to get by them. Vihneek also has a useful instinct vision mode activated by holding L2 that locks him in place, but lets him see things like enemy vision cones and interactable objects that might let him drop a box from a crane onto an enemy, as one example. The right stick can also move the camera a few feet in any direction, including up or down, which I often found helpful in locating the next ledge or exit I needed to reach.
Get It Twisted

The level design reminded me a fair bit of Hollow Knight in the way it rewarded exploration and made me stop and think about how to navigate certain rooms. While trying to escape, Vihneek can go searching for precious warpstone – the magical space cocaine (yes, really) that Skaven are obsessed with, as it's what caused them to evolve into intelligent humanoids in the first place and powers much of their technology. This is optional, but it also gives you additional skill points. More on that in a bit.

Eventually, I came across a shield that I could use in a pinch to bash the guards' brains out, which changed the gameplay flow a bit. Instead of simply having to sneak and hide, I could get behind normal enemies and execute them in a gory display of malice with a single button tap. Running, or even dropping down from a high spot, makes noise though, so I still had to be careful.

Also, my pathetic piece of sharp wood didn't do any good when I ended up getting chased by a rat ogre, only to be saved by a mysterious white rodent with blades for a hand who didn't offer me much choice but to be recruited into his clan.

This is where things get more interesting, though. Vihneek is inducted as a Night Runner, which are kind of like the elite ninja assassins of the Skaven world. The job comes with a rad new outfit, but more importantly, a new suite of powers. The first of these, unlocked right away, is a grappling hook that allowed me to zip up to various locations that were previously inaccessible. The rest are purchased with warpstone and include everything from silencing your footsteps to being able to deploy smoke bombs. Sadly, I wasn't able to return to the clan hideout to purchase these during the demo.
Skitter-Slash

This is the point that Deathmaster starts to feel like a bit more of a power fantasy. You're still quite fragile, but I got the sense that I had become the predator and everyone else was now the prey. Okay, maybe not that rat ogre. Each area became a bit like a puzzle as I scanned for environmental traps, distractions, and hiding places to figure out which guards I could get the drop on, and in which order, without alerting their friends.

The platforming itself wasn't especially difficult, at least so far, but careful observation of the subterranean world often led me to a warpstone reward. The name of the game is much more slow and thorough progression as opposed to tricky execution, although there were some rooms where I had to enact my plan quickly to not get caught by a guard.

The story, however, is still a little bit murky. I'm not sure why Vihneek was dropped into a pit like so much rotting garbage. We don't know why he has some kind of odd, glowing appendage literally welded onto where the back half of his tail used to be, or why his clanmates jeeringly call him "half-rat." All of the violence so far has been of the Skaven-on-Skaven variety. And that's very appropriate. The main reason the Vermintide hasn't overtaken the world yet in this universe is that the children of the Great Horned Rat spend as much time plotting against and murdering each other as they do the other races.
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/01/wh-deathmaster-screen-02-1788297803546.png

My first mission was to take out a rival clan's gnawhole, which is essentially a passage even deeper into the world they can use to summon reinforcements. Before I could get there, though, the unfortunately brief 30-minute demo ended. We did get to see a little bit more hands-off, including a boss fight with a deadly Stormvermin that requires Vihneek to use the environment – and ultimately a warpstone-powered lightning cannon – to win a battle that would leave him broken and discarded if he fought fair. And what good Skaven fights fair?

I had a maniacally delightful time with the very small slice of Warhammer Age of Sigmar: Deathmaster I got to chew on. The art style is gloomy and grimy while remaining very readable. The mixture of stealth game mainstays with Hollow Knight-stye platforming clicks together pretty seamlessly. Exploring and backstabbing my way through its sometimes tricky areas as I gradually gained access to new abilities kept things fresh. And seeing Age of Sigmar from a Skaven's beady little eyes makes it all seem new again. A bit moldy, maybe, but new.

items.title: 10 年后，《Pokémon Go》将推出 Pokémon 动漫跨界剧集
items.summary: The world of Pokémon Go will cross over into the Pokémon anime series, in an episode where the gang meet Profe

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/02/pokmon-horizons-next-episodes-preview-pokmon-go-in-the-anime-professor-willow-and-friedes-past-00-00-22-1788360452156.png
The world of Pokémon Go will cross over into the Pokémon anime series later this month, in an episode where the gang meet Professor Willow and spin a PokéStop.

Pokémon Go celebrated its 10th anniversary this summer, and the celebrations will continue this month as a landmark episode of the Pokémon Horizons series debuts in Japan on September 18, featuring a couple of very special guest stars.

Yes, Professor Willow himself will be making his anime debut, leaping over from his role assisting players in Pokémon Go. Coming along with him is Meltan, his partner Pokémon, and at least one PokéStop — the identifiers of real-world locations that Pokémon Go players spin in-game.
9月18日（金）18時55分から、『Pokémon GO』とアニポケのコラボエピソード放送が決定！ 『Pokémon GO』内でも、テレビアニメコラボが開催されるよ。 コラボPVが解禁されたから、チェックしてね！ https://t.co/VzJHnpeL7y #アニポケ #ポケモンGO pic.twitter.com/TWKMfTl5Wa

In a trailer posted today by the official Japanese Pokémon social media account, above Captain Pikachu can be seen spinning the PokéStop, accurately recieving Pokéballs and berries as a reward. And in a further nod, a Kecleon is revealed to have been hiding in plain sight — a neat nod to how the chameleon-like creature can be caught in Pokémon Go.

Exactly how Professor Willow will cross paths with Roy, Liko and the series' other characters remains to be seen, as Go's canonicity with the rest of the Pokémon franchise has always been left unclear. Indeed, Meltan and Melmetal, which debuted first in Pokémon Go, lack an official region of origin (such as Johto or Kanto), and are instead listed as being discovered in an "Unidentified" place.

Regardless, Pokémon Horizons and Go will also crossover together within Pokémon Go itself, with the episode's Charizard wearing goggles available to catch in Go, as well as a return for Captain Pikachu. All of that takes place between September 16 and 22, around the time the special episode airs first in Japan. In the U.S., fans can start watching Pokémon Horizons: Season 3 via Netflix, while in the U.K. the series debuts on BBC iPlayer.
Tom Phillips is IGN's News Editor. You can reach Tom at tom_phillips@ign.com or find him on Bluesky @tomphillipseg.bsky.social

items.title: 我一直担心《女神异闻录》会变得乏味，但《女神异闻录 4 复兴》感觉和 16 年前的前作一样好
items.summary: Same vibes, different look.

content.v: Persona 5 was so damn successful, it's unsurprising that Atlus has spent the years since A) milking the hell out of it and B) using its incredibly stylish visuals as a template to remake the other two games in its modern trilogy.

Persona 3 Reload was the first utilisation of that template, and now we're doing it all over again with Persona 4 Revival. Its cast of characters un-chibified, ready to be unleashed upon a far more highly detailed rendition of the cosy town of Inaba.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/AFZUMubGSmuf2spR7UjnmN.png

Honestly, I was a little worried sitting down to play Persona 4 Revival at Gamescom . Its predecessor, Persona 4 Golden, was my introduction to the series and hugely formative for me. It's a game I hold incredibly close to my heart, one I've played countless times over. I've been carrying around this gnawing feeling that Atlus' ongoing attempts to bring a cohesive art style to the series was going to be its undoing. Would Revival still feel like the Persona 4 I know and love?

I'm incredibly relieved to say that the answer to that is: it absolutely does. It's a little different, sure—most of the English voice cast has been swapped out, the soundtrack has been re-recorded and rearranged, and I'm still not totally sold on its updated character portraits (seriously, where is Yosuke's jawline?)

But as I played my way through small snippets of the game's early hours—retreading the familiar territory of Yukiko's castle and facing off against Shadow Chie—I was getting those same giddy feelings that I felt the first time I booted up Persona 4 Golden on my PS Vita.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/2eCKgXR7oQLMrv5yRz9PdN.png

That doesn't mean there aren't new things to awe at and explore for veterans of Inaba's streets, mind you. The foggy town is now fully explorable in 3D, and plodding up and down its winding roads revealed to me a faithfully recreated space with all the fun details and finesse that older hardware couldn't afford. It's still got those wonderful vibes that teeter between cosy and mildly unsettling.

And while Persona 4 Revival's dungeons have stayed true to the original's procedurally-generated corridor format (something I'm still unsure about), there are plenty of tweaks to exploration and combat that shake things up. Shadows are still as relentlessly aggressive as they were the first time around, but Revival has added in a guard mechanic that lets you stun them to get the upper hand. It's a nice addition for those that are perhaps more used to the covert sneaking promoted in Persona 5, and saves me from endlessly trying to get around their back for an advantage.

The game's modern makeover truly shines in the heart of Persona 4 Revival's battles. The shadow designs are fantastic— the tongue-lolling Hablerie looks even more disturbing in the best possible way, and the extra details and textures on Shadow Chie make its already-incredible visuals pop. Pretty much every shadow has been elevated with a few tweaks here and there instead of going for full-blown remakes, a decision I'm really pleased about.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/eJi3JV6cUGjtj3J9Gs6jvN.png

Then there's the actual combat stuff. The classic "1 More" system returns, but it's now folded in with Persona 5's Baton Pass that lets you pass the extra attack onto an ally. There's also a brand-new mechanic that lets you send shadows flying into each other to pass on status ailments and deal extra damage, something I didn't get to play around with in my time with the demo but I'm very excited about regardless.

Prime Time seems to be the main addition to combat, another one I didn't really get to use during the demo—filling a gauge lets you perform a whole bunch of actions and skills without coughing up the HP or MP for them, as well as ignoring resistances and freely using Baton Passes. It seems like something that's going to be utterly broken as a concept, and I'm interested in seeing how Atlus plans on balancing something that seems so bonkers powerful.

Mostly, I'm just ridiculously excited to jump back in and play more. Persona 5 may be the most well-known in the series at this point, but Persona 4 is easily my favourite in terms of raw vibes and storytelling. Being able to recapture that feeling 16 years after Golden is no easy feat, but from the small parts of Revival I've played so far, Atlus has absolutely nailed it.

items.summary: In what feels like a monkey's paw situation, Super Smash Bros. Ultimate unexpectedly received a new patch--but

content.v: In what feels like a monkey's paw situation, Super Smash Bros. Ultimate unexpectedly received a new patch--but unlike recent updates for other major Nintendo games, this Smash update doesn't include any Switch 2-specific features.

The Ver. 13.0.5 patch for Ultimate fixes "behavior that occurs when invalid data is sent or received in online battles," according to the Nintendo Support website . It isn't clear from the patch notes (or note, rather) what "invalid data" refers to, but some users on Reddit speculated that the update targets mods.

Meanwhile, fellow Switch 1 game Mario Kart 8 Deluxe received a hefty 4.0.0 update with substantial features for Switch 2 users, including split-screen support for up to eight players, camera support, shorter loading times, and higher resolutions. Pikmin 3 Deluxe also got a similar Switch 2 update this week.

It's a disappointing time for Smash Bros. fans, with not a single hint of a new Smash game or a proper Switch 2 update for Ultimate, whether that comes in the form of a free patch or a Switch 2 Edition with new content.

There's a laundry list of features that players would love to see in a Switch 2 version of Smash Bros. Ultimate , including new characters, additional stages, increased resolution, and implementation of rollback netcode. The only Switch 2-related update that Ultimate received came in June 2025 , fixing an issue where online matches with Mii Fighters would end immediately if one of the players was playing on a Switch 2.

Development for new content ended in 2021 after the addition of Sora from Kingdom Hearts capped off Ultimate's DLC. The latest title from Smash Bros. creator Masahiro Sakurai is Kirby Air Riders, which launched last November with no DLC planned . Perhaps Smash fans should bet on a new Smash game coming instead of an Ultimate update, though we can probably all agree that Sakurai deserves a break .

items.title: 不关心 GTA 6 的浪漫系统吗？开发人员说，不要使用它
items.summary: GTA 6 's Jason and Lucia can be romantically involved , or they can just be partners in crime. If you're not i

content.v: GTA 6 's Jason and Lucia can be romantically involved , or they can just be partners in crime. If you're not interested in the game's romance system, don't use it, Rockstar's Rob Nelson said in a new interview.
"I have to say it feels great--if you are into it as a concept. Don’t bother with it if you aren’t. Up to you," Nelson told IGN .

Players who do wish to grow and nurture a romantic relationship between Jason and Lucia can hold hands, visit a zoo together, or enjoy a romantic stroll on the beach, Nelson said. If players don’t want to do those things, they don’t have to, but Nelson said players might miss out on other things.

"I don’t want to say too much more about this because I don’t want to spoil anything. It really adds a compelling element to things, and it’s one of the reasons we wanted to approach this sort of story, because it's completely different for us," Nelson said. "Could we bring some sort of emotional resonance to GTA for people if they wanted to engage with it? Could we also provide mechanisms for people to just opt out of it if they're not into it? If they feel like, ‘I don't want a relationship in this?’ That's what we're going to find out. It's not something that we want to foist upon players."
Nelson said players might grow to "feel protective of [Jason and Lucia] as a unit" as they progress through the game, and the developers at Rockstar didn't originally envision this.

"This is something we did not know when we started, and it really had to be something we felt our way through. But I will say that whether you’re getting in trouble, or you’re running from the cops, or getting in a car, or waiting for the other one--playing as them together feels very cool. It feels like you’re taking care of them, if that’s something you’re into," he said.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Screenshot-2026-09-02-at-10.09.57-AM-1.png?w=636
Players will need to manage the relationship by responding to texts and, like in any good relationship, making an effort.
“It’s new for GTA, this idea of your actions having meaning in terms of how you treat your partner or how violent you are ,” Nelson said in another interview.
Nelson went on to say GTA 6’s story will take cues from “that Bonnie and Clyde concept.” He added, “We knew it was the only way for us to go with this game.”
Bonnie and Clyde were famous American outlaws from the early 1900s who committed many crimes, including murder. They were lovers, and they were eventually killed by the police in 1934 in Louisiana.

GTA 6 launches on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. We learned a lot more about the game today, including how the map is 3X bigger than Red Dead Redemption 2’s and that a playthrough can be 80 hours long . The game also brings back six-star wanted levels , and that you can pet the dog .

items.title: 扎克·克雷格将把“游戏的资源管理方面”带入他的《生化危机》电影中
items.summary: He's gonna need a bigger attache case.

content.v: I have high expectations for Zach Cregger's upcoming Resident Evil film. As a superb director and seemingly a genuine fan of the games it really feels as if he's got the vibe of Resident Evil down , demonstrated by his inclusion of little easter eggs, choice of location, and now choice to highlight a staple of the Resident Evil games: their resource management.

"I love the resource management aspect of the games and it was really important to me to bring that to the movie," Cregger says in a Reddit AMA . He loves it so much, in fact, that viewers will be able to follow the protagonist Bryan's management.

"You will know how many bullets are in his gun," Cregger adds. "You will care when he misses a shot. That's one of the things that makes the games feel so intense and it translates really well into the film (in my opinion)."

One of the funniest clips I've seen from the Resident Evil film so far has to be Bryan cautiously lining up a shot at a padlock hanging from a door handle, sheepishly covering his ear with his spare hand, and then missing the shot. As someone who knows what the pain of wasting ammo in a RE game feels like, that resonated in my soul.

But it's not all just about ammo, as with any survival horror game, healing supplies are also at a premium. "I also want viewers to be keenly aware of his health as he progresses," Cregger adds. "Won't say much about that but it's another way to utilize the game mechanic that heightens the narrative engine of the movie."

I can think of several ways in which Cregger may be able to implement some health mechanics from the games. If he wants to reference earlier Resident Evil games, there could be a scene wherein Bryan is hooked up to a ECG monitor that's bright red if he's in particularly bad shape. There's obviously the classic limp that Bryan will probably do if he's hurt—although that's less of a reference to Resident Evil 4 and more of a reference to hurting your leg really bad.

Something that could look cool if done correctly could even be using screen effects on a first-person POV, which we've seen in recent games. Something like Bryan's sight having a red hue as his eyes fill with blood—it could go nicely with some loud and rapid heartbeat noises. Cregger has even previously discussed how the film will have a few first-person POV scenes .

But what I want more than anything else isn't to see Bryan blue or bloody—I want to see him try and organise an attache case like it's some twisted game of Tetris, ultimately failing to find a space for just one more bag of scraps. On the flip side, it'd be fun to see Bryan start to encounter more handgun ammo after he picks up a random silver case—I have a feeling he'll need it as well.

items.title: 杰洛特的配音演员是否受到亨利·卡维尔在《巫师》系列中为他配音的启发？ “不，因为我们是第一”
items.summary: “我还没有接到客串的电话，”丹德里恩 VA 约翰·施瓦布 (John Schwab) 说道。
items.titleEn: Was Geralt's voice actor inspired by Henry Cavill's take on him in The Witcher series? 'No, because we were first'

content.v: 人们常说，好的艺术家借用，而伟大的艺术家则偷窃。鉴于《巫师 3》中利维亚杰洛特的配音演员道格·科克尔 (Doug Cockle) 一直处于罕见的地位，能够在流媒体电视上看到他在电子游戏中扮演的角色多年的首次亮相，并由亨利·卡维尔 (Henry Cavill)（现在是利亚姆·海姆斯沃斯 (Liam Hemsworth)）饰演过一段时间，你可能想知道他是否做了任何记录。
“不，”他在 Gamescom 2026 上告诉 PC Gamer 的 Joshua Wolens。 “因为我们是第一。”
杰洛特的老朋友丹德里恩的配音演员约翰·施瓦布 (John Schwab) 也加入了一些对 Netflix 的友好玩笑：“我还没有接到客串的电话。你呢？”他问科克尔。 “不！” Cockle replies, to which Schwab emphatically says: "Come on, guys!"
科克尔确实说，他要求剧集制作人——尽管还不清楚这是否是一个笑话——“让我参与每一集。把我放在后台。拉一个斯坦·李什么的，你知道吗？拉一个斯坦·李。但他们做到了吗？没有。”
尽管正在进行友好的肘击，但施瓦布还是很快表达了他的赞美：“我喜欢丹德里恩，我喜欢贾斯基尔，他是一个有趣的人。我真的认为[乔伊·贝蒂]在寻找深度方面确实做得很好，而且它走了一条完全不同的路。
“但是就像——你知道，道格，你在《无事生非》中扮演本尼迪克特吗？道格不是第一个扮演这个角色的人。所以你创造了你的杰洛特，”他强调说：“我认为他们从你那里偷了东西——得了吧，公平点。”
道格回应道：“嗯——嗯，”施瓦布在背景中窃笑。 “亨利公开表示，我饰演杰洛特的表演——我不记得他是否使用了‘知情’或‘启发’了他的表演方法。他没有模仿我，他说‘道格扮演的杰洛特很酷，我想做类似的事情’，然后他把它变成了他自己的。无论如何，这是所有艺术家所做和应该做的。他做得非常出色。”
我们将让 Cockle 在《巫师 3》即将推出的 DLC《过去之歌》中完成他自己定制的出色工作，乔什在其中看到了它的实际效果。

items.title: 传《GTA6》PS5 Pro版本将有更高分辨率和帧数
items.summary: 有消息称，《GTA6》可能会在PS5 Pro上提供更高的帧率，而最新的一则爆料进一步点燃了这一传闻。 知名舅舅摩尔定律已死曝光了索尼针对“PS5 Pro Enhanced（PS5 Pro增强版）”标识制定的严格标准，只有

content.v: 有消息称，《GTA6》可能会在PS5 Pro上提供更高的帧率，而最新的一则爆料进一步点燃了这一传闻。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260902/1788356978_466626_jpg_r.jpg
知名舅舅摩尔定律已死曝光了索尼针对“PS5 Pro Enhanced（PS5 Pro增强版）”标识制定的严格标准，只有达到特定技术要求的游戏，才能获得这一认证。
据爆料，索尼曾向Rockstar施压，要求《GTA6》在PS5 Pro上实现明显的性能提升。由于《GTA6》目前已经获得了PS5 Pro Enhanced标识，因此理论上它必须满足索尼设定的相关标准。这也让外界进一步猜测，《GTA6》可能会在PS5 Pro上提供40FPS甚至60FPS性能模式。
据其消息人士透露，他们拿到了一份索尼内部文件的改写版本，其中详细说明了开发商想要获得“PS5 Pro Enhanced”标识需要满足的技术条件。据称，包括Rockstar在内的部分工作室都曾受到索尼方面的压力，需要满足这份技术标准。
摩尔定律已死的消息人士表示：“我们知道，PS5 Pro Enhanced是《GTA6》已经拥有的标识……所以我们知道，他们必须满足这些标准……索尼在文件中直接写明，他们希望看到更高的帧率、光线追踪以及更高的分辨率。”
根据相关标准，游戏如果想获得PS5 Pro Enhanced标识，需要在分辨率、帧率或光线追踪等方面实现明确的性能提升。例如提供更高分辨率、更高FPS，或者明显增强光线追踪效果。
摩尔定律已死进一步表示，索尼很可能会强力推动Rockstar提升《GTA6》的帧率，因为如果游戏能够在PS5 Pro上实现更高帧率，这将成为索尼宣传PS5 Pro的一大卖点。因此，《GTA6》在PS5 Pro上提供40FPS或60FPS模式的可能性进一步增加。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260902/1788356992_973610_jpg_r.jpg
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260902/1788356993_318351_jpg_r.jpg
值得注意的是，仅仅进行一些幅度很小的性能升级，并不足以让游戏获得PS5 Pro Enhanced标识。因此，即便《GTA6》最终在PS5 Pro上仍然只能以30FPS运行，也不意味着不会有其他方面的明显增强，例如更高的分辨率或更强的光线追踪效果，而且这些提升理论上应该会明显区别于普通PS5版本。
作为参考，据Digital Foundry此前的分析，《GTA6》在普通PS5上的原生分辨率据称为1440p，随后通过升频提升至4K。

items.summary: Kingdom Come developer Warhorse is working on multiple new games, including a The Lord of the Rings role-playi

content.v: Kingdom Come developer Warhorse is working on multiple new games, including a The Lord of the Rings role-playing game . We don't know much about it right now, and Warhorse isn't likely to share more details anytime soon.

In a post on social media , Warhorse said, "We're excited to tell you guys more, you've just gotta be patient for now." In short, you should be more like an Ent and slow down. Good things come to those who wait, after all.
Warhorse announced the game earlier this year, saying it will be a "deeply immersive" open-world Middle-earth RPG.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Screenshot-2026-09-02-at-9.30.15-AM-1.png

The game will feature a “living world” populated by “interesting characters, memorable places, and, of course, a strong narrative focus," the developers said. This doesn't tell us much about it, but it’s a starting point for understanding where the game may be headed. We also know that Deliverance 2 design director Viktor Bocan is leading the development of the untitled Lord of the Rings game.
In addition to the new Lord of the Rings game, Warhorse is producing a new Kingdom Come game , along with a Kingdom Come movie .

As for the Lord of the Rings game series, Tomb Raider studio Crystal Dynamics is said to be working on its own game as well . Both Crystal Dynamics and Warhorse are owned by Embracer, which controls the rights to The Lord of the Rings.
Beyond these games, Aspyr Media has teased more re-releases of classic The Lord of the Rings games following the shadow-drop of War in the North .

The Lord of the Rings series remains popular outside of games, too. Prime Video’s The Rings of Power series returns for a third season this November and Andy Serkis is directing The Hunt for Gollum, which will be out in 2027.

items.title: 《大哥斯拉：消灭所有怪物近战重制版》专访：针对《GTA 6》推出、砍掉 Hedorah 以及（大部分）忠实于 GameCube 经典
items.summary: IGN spoke with Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered senior designer Simon Strange to hear about the

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/31/godzilla-destroy-all-monsters-melee-remastered-interview-1788146249461.png

IGN gave Atari and Pipeworks' Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee an 8.4/10 review when it launched in 2002. At the time, we said, "as far as multiplayer experiences go, Godzilla represents one of GameCube's very best." Now, senior designer Simon Strange and the rest of the team are back and ready to do it all over again.

Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered is something fans have pleaded for but never thought would actually happen . After all, it's been 24 years since the original game came out, and with no sign of the arena brawler series since Godzilla: Unleashed stomped onto the scene in 2007, there's been little hope for a proper return. That changes this November .

With remastered graphics, a playable Showa-era Mechagodzilla, and a few new irradiated bells and whistles, Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered is set to arrive at a time when kaiju fans are in desperate need of a standalone game featuring the King of the Monsters. IGN spoke with Strange to learn about how things have changed since he first helped bring the original game to players in the 2000s.

From the decision to cut the Smog Monster, Hedorah, to launching so close to GTA 6 and the potential for Godzilla: Save the Earth and Godzilla: Unleashed remasters, we talked about (almost) everything Godzilla fans could ever want to know about Pipeworks' return to the franchise. You can read the conversation in its entirety below while we wait for Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered to launch for PC via Steam, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X/S November 3, 2026.
IGN: It's been almost 24 years since the original Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee came out. Why do a remaster now, and why is 2026 the perfect time for more Godzilla from Pipeworks?

Simon Strange: We've been wanting to do a remake of this game for years. We've talked about it for at least a decade. A big obstacle for a lot of that time was that the original game was made in our own proprietary engine, which is called Spigot. Internally, we still have a lot of the engineers who worked on Spigot, and we said, 'If we wanted to revise these games, does that mean bringing Spigot up, getting back into that, working it with the new versions of DirectX, having to support all the new consoles?' We're very much an engineering company. The engineering behind revitalizing the old engine was the big obstacle, but a different idea that came up two, two and a half years ago is that part of our Spigot engine was we compiled all of our data into a proprietary format.

One of the engineers who had written those compilers was like, 'I could just write a tool that would recompile those into generic formats that are used by other engines.' He did that, so we were suddenly able to bring all of those assets from the original game out of Spigot and put them into other engines, like Unreal, in this case. As soon as we could do that, I just started playing around with stuff, and I was like, 'Oh, look, I got the characters working. Oh, look, I brought the cities in.' Then we were basically off to the races.

Then, it was just a matter of getting in touch with Atari, getting in touch with Toho, and 'Look what we've got!' We started to put all the things together. So, that was really sort of the genesis there, is that, instead of using the old engine and bringing it up to modern standards, bringing the assets out of the old engine into new engines that are already working on modern standards.

A couple of questions from that, then. So, it's called Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered, but there are some new elements as well. Why call it a remaster and not a remake? How did you define that line?

Strange: Oh, that was a long discussion. Ultimately, remaster is just a term that people understand. If you say remake, people say, 'What exactly is that?' and then you have to explain it. This is not a strict remaster. The way that I think about the term… I mean, remaster makes sense in music recording, right? We are definitely using many of the original assets. Most importantly, all of the animations for the characters are exactly pulled out of the old game. It's all just the same animations, but for example, all the meshes on the characters, the textures on the buildings, the lighting, the VFX – that stuff is just new.

We just built new things for there, but it's a fighting game, so the character animations, I think, are really the core. I mean, that's the area that I work on most, and so those are exactly the same. The audio is exactly the same. The feel and the controls and the button layouts, exactly the same. When you play through the adventure mode, it's exactly the same sequence of the fights. We do have some elements that are exactly the same. We have some elements that are all new, but are built to evoke the old game, and then we have some elements that are just new.

So, 'remaster?' Just for clarity. Just to not confuse people. That's really where we came with that. I think remake is more correct, but there are elements that are exactly the same. So, 40% is remastered directly from the original source, 60% is new.

I remember seeing that Pipeworks logo flash on the screen when I think back to the 2000s. How much of the original team is back working on this game? How many have stuck around through all those years?
Strange: Not very many.

I mean, this is 25 years ago that I started working on this game. In fact, it was almost exactly 25. I started at Pipeworks in November of 2001, and the team had already started on the Godzilla game. I was brought in specifically to work on the Godzilla game.

I think we have six people who have worked on at least one of the Godzilla games up through Godzilla: Unleashed. That's through 2007. We have, of that original original team, three or maybe four. We definitely have four people still at the studio who worked on that original game, and at least three of them have directly contributed, one of whom being the original engineer who wrote the exporter. There's myself being the game design lead, and then our technical director and one of our senior producers also have been making contributions.
Certainly, we're playing the game, being like, 'Well, didn't we do it this way? Why don't we have the spotlight?' So, that's a lot of fun.
What was it like revisiting your relationship with Toho and the license holders? What has it been like working with them on this game again?

Strange: I really appreciate Toho. They're very exacting. They are not a hands-off kind of team. They're in there, and they get into the minutiae, and I quite appreciate that. You have to really schedule time. You have to do more iterations with them than you would with other license holders, but as long as you have that in mind, it's not a big deal.

My experience from the original series of games was that it was pretty rough for the first game, but then, as we established those relationships, Godzilla: Save the Earth and Godzilla: Unleashed got much, much faster and easier as we built up that level of trust. So, we're restarting some of that, so things are taking a while again, but that's OK. That's good. That's part of the process. We're doing this because we're not making an original game; we're using the Godzilla license, and we want to get the license right. We want to be respectful to the company and to the fans, and that's part of the fun.

items.title: CDPR：《巫师4》画面和感觉都不会像其他虚幻5游戏
items.summary: 《巫师4》因改用虚幻5引擎，导致很多玩家担忧该作将会和其他虚幻5大作一个画风。然而，开发团队表示，这种情况不会发生。在接受游戏商业采访时，联席CEO Michal Nowakowski讨论了向虚幻5引擎的过渡以及这将对工

content.v: 《巫师4》因改用虚幻5引擎，导致很多玩家担忧该作将会和其他虚幻5大作一个画风。然而，开发团队表示，这种情况不会发生。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260902/1788356548_722533.webp
在接受游戏商业采访时，联席CEO Michal Nowakowski讨论了向虚幻5引擎的过渡以及这将对工作室产生的影响。
众所周知，Red擎拥有独特的风格和画面，而许多人则认为虚幻5引擎的游戏感觉有些千篇一律。Michal Nowakowski解释称，《巫师4》将凭借其独特的引擎与其他游戏区分开来。
“我们不会做（另一款画面风格类似虚幻引擎的游戏）。我们真的能够脱颖而出。”
他表示，游戏的技术对大多数玩家来说并不重要。开发团队与Epic Games密切合作，并格外注重确保《巫师4》保留了CDPR近年来作品中一直秉持的独特元素。
当然，虚幻5引擎已经被用来制作许多视觉效果独特的游戏，比如《漫威斗魂》、《七龙珠 电光炸裂！ZERO》、《光与影：33号远征队》等游戏，充分展现了虚幻5引擎游戏在经过调整和采用不同的美术风格后，画面可以呈现出多么丰富的多样性。因此，CDPR希望《巫师4》也能以类似的方式建立起自己独特的风格。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

items.title: 对于犯罪太过分的玩家来说，《GTA 6》将是一条不归路
items.summary: 《侠盗猎车手 6》希望为其几个既定的游戏支柱添加一些额外的内容，但
items.titleEn: GTA 6 Has A Point Of No Return For Players Who Take Crime Too Far

content.v: 《侠盗猎车手 6》希望为其几个既定的游戏支柱添加一些额外的细节，但这里最大的更新可能只是加入了荣誉系统。借鉴 Red Dead Redemption 2 的经验，GTA 6 会提醒您，行为会产生后果，因为您的不合法活动将逐渐形成犯罪档案。其中不仅有各种配置文件可以衡量你在犯罪或嗜血方面的效率，而且如果你造成太多混乱，开发商 Rockstar Games 会让你彻底打破它。

“玩游戏的方式没有正确或错误之分，”GTA 6 开发联席主管 Rob Nelson 对 YouTuber TGG 说道。 “现在多了一点选择。如果你的行为可能会对事情产生一些影响，你想怎么玩这个游戏？如果你想这么做的话，你仍然可以造成尽可能多的混乱。我不认为它改变了 GTA 的本质。它改变了那些想要以这种方式参与其中的人的生活。你仍然拥有像以前一样多的自由；你现在可以做更多的事情，并且在如何处理情况方面你有更多的选择。”
在最高级别，玩家可以有犯罪记录，将他们标记为“职业”，从那里，状态会下降到攻击性、暴力性和心理性。据说达到第五种（目前未命名的状态）特别困难，但一旦达到，就不会再完全陷入邪恶。这个想法是，玩家可以自由地在犯罪档案之间切换或重玩游戏，同时旨在与这些特定的州保持一致。

Players can also disable notifications about their profile status changing, and the co-protagonists Jason and Lucia will each have their own profile that changes throughout the course of the game depending on the actions you take with them.
How these states ultimately influence the story of GTA 6 has yet to be revealed, but we'd wager that being a homicidal loose cannon probably won't end well by the time that the end credits roll.

GTA 6 将包含其他几个旨在增强游戏真实感的功能。 Non-playable characters will notice if you're carrying weapons out in public , cars require more finesse to steal , and yes, you can throw dog poop at people. At the same time, Rockstar has also removed one of the worst legacy features from GTA 6, as you'll no longer need to wear your thumb out when you're outrunning cops by mashing a single button .

items.title: 尽管成本上涨，《巫师 4》开发者“并不担心”游戏机的未来
items.summary: CD Projekt 联合首席执行官 Michał Nowakowski 对游戏机的未来“并不担心”，尽管成本不断上涨
items.titleEn: Witcher 4 Dev “Not Worried” About Future Of Consoles Despite Rising Costs

content.v: CD Projekt joint-CEO Michał Nowakowski is "not worried" about the future of consoles, despite rising costs that could impact growth in the sector .
诺瓦科夫斯基在接受《游戏商业》采访时表示，对于休闲和半休闲玩家来说，游戏机仍然是“扩大受众范围的必要工具”。 "It’s important to have easy to plug in and enjoy gaming," he said.
他表示，游戏机将“渡过目前面临的风暴”，包括定价。诺瓦科夫斯基还表示，他听说了 PS6 和下一代 Xbox 可能会被推迟的传言，但他说，“我不知道这些是否属实。”
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Screenshot-2026-09-02-at-9.07.40-AM-1.png?w=636
Nowakowski 表示，总的来说，CD Projekt 不会花太多时间担心公司如何接触到人们。 “内容为王。如果内容正确，人们就会找到玩它的方式，”这位高管表示。

CD Projekt 的开发人员会要求“尽可能多的能力”，以帮助以尽可能最好的方式展示游戏。 However, Nowakowski said the developers at CD Projekt are "realistic," too, so if next-gen consoles get delayed, some ideas that would require new, more powerful hardware might get "put on a shelf for the future."
“我们必须进行调整。我们并不担心商业方面。游戏机将继续存在，”他说。
CD Projekt has multiple games in the works that are likely planned for new consoles, as The Witcher 4 is lined up for release in 2028, with Cyberpunk 2 likely coming sometime after.

由于全球市场因素，包括关税和人工智能推动的组件和内存需求，索尼、微软和任天堂提高了硬件价格。 Xbox 首席执行官阿莎·夏尔马 (Asha Sharma) 最近表示，GPU 在游戏之外的应用场景“很棒”，即使这意味着 Xbox 游戏机现在比以往任何时候都更加昂贵。就任天堂而言，它已收到特朗普总统关税的退款（这被认为是非法的），但表示没有法律要求将任何钱转给支付更多费用的消费者。与此同时，索尼也获得了巨额关税退款，但没有计划转嫁任何东西。
有传言称，下一波新游戏机的价格可能会达到 1,000 美元或更高，这可能会对整个市场产生巨大的负面影响。

items.title: 《GTA6》最新细节 枪战与移动机制迎来重大革新
items.summary: 《GTA6》最新细节曝光，揭示了《GTA6》在枪战、武器和移动方面更进一步。《GTA6》在战斗与交互上有了重大改变，游戏不仅重塑了武器携带与人车互动逻辑（如角色间亲手递枪、专属车辆存储限制及NPC对持枪姿态的动态反应），

content.v: 《GTA6》最新细节曝光，揭示了《GTA6》在枪战、武器和移动方面更进一步。
《GTA6》在战斗与交互上有了重大改变，游戏不仅重塑了武器携带与人车互动逻辑（如角色间亲手递枪、专属车辆存储限制及NPC对持枪姿态的动态反应），还调高了枪战门槛，转向更具挑战性的默认自由瞄准与强后坐力弹道;同时结合敌人在小地图隐匿、分级命中反馈以及继承自《荒野大镖客2》的视角与战术动作，为玩家打造出沉浸感更强、策略性更高的战斗体验。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260902/1788345388_980599_jpg_r.jpg
最新细节：
Jason和Lucia可以互相亲手递交武器，允许玩家在两个角色之间直接转移武器。
《GTA6》默认将更倾向于自由瞄准，而非传统的强力锁定瞄准。设置中仍保留部分瞄准黏性，且可以进行调节。
长枪可以存放在任何车辆中，但只有个人专属车辆能持久保留所选的完整武器装备。临时车辆不具备持久保留功能。
NPC的反应取决于携带武器的方式。背着长枪通常不会引发麻烦，而手中拿着长枪可能会让路人避开。警察可能会发出警告，如果处于随时准备开火的持枪状态，局势将会升级。
战斗期间敌人不会出现在小地图上，这延续了之前透露的警察不会出现在小地图上的变化。
命中标记在战斗中提供不同的反馈：普通命中为白色，敌人丧失行动能力时为黄色，击杀敌人时为红色。
玩家始终可以携带两把隐蔽的手枪以及最多两把长枪。角色背部只能存放一把长枪，这意味着第二把必须拿在手里。
与《给他爱5》相比，武器具有明显的更强后坐力和冲击力。在试玩预览中，突击步枪需要更多受控的短点射和单点开火来保持准确度。
击杀镜头可以关闭，同时武器快速切换功能也宣告回归。
蹲下时玩家可以侧向平移移动，掩体键在PlayStation上依然映射为R1，来自《荒野大镖客2》的切肩视角功能也已回归。
玩家可以自定义默认移动速度，包括正常步行或更快的慢跑等选项。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

items.title: 索尼警告 PlayStation 客户不要在光盘抵制中骚扰支持人员
items.summary: 索尼取消 PlayStation 游戏光盘的决定自推出以来几乎遭到了普遍的蔑视。
items.titleEn: Sony Warns PlayStation Customers Against Harassing Support Staff Amid Disc Backlash

content.v: Sony's decision to kill off PlayStation game discs has been met with almost universal disdain since it was first announced, and it looks like its employees have been caught in the crossfire. Just about every Sony announcement or social media post is met with calls for it to reverse its decision, and Sony Japan has instituted a new anti-harassment policy to protect the customer service employees who have had to deal with a vocal contingent of dissatisfied consumers.

这些变化也符合将于今年晚些时候生效的日本新工作场所法。 "Similar to other companies in Japan, Sony Interactive Entertainment has published its policy in compliance with a new law taking effect on October 1, which requires employers in Japan to implement measures to address customer harassment," Sony said in response to GameSpot.

According to the policy , Sony will restrict people who "exceed what is considered reasonable" when interacting with customer service, including "unreasonable demands" for compensation or apologies. Abusive language, threats, and "forcing someone to prostrate themselves" can also get you cut off from the help desk, as will visiting offices or related facilities without permission.索尼补充说，如有必要，它将与警方和律师合作，以保护其员工。
虽然客户服务人员目前正在应对索尼决定专注于全数字未来的强烈反对，但该公司也因最近的几项行动而受到批评。索尼回应了一项集体诉讼，该诉讼被指控没有明确告知消费者其数字商店出售游戏许可，而不是完整游戏。多家出版商还指责索尼采取反竞争行为，并试图通过其数字店面创造垄断。作为数字游戏价格和解协议的一部分，索尼将向 PlayStation 客户支付近 800 万美元。
尽管有所有这些负面报道，该公司仍在“谨慎地推进”其结束游戏光盘生产的计划，因为没有任何负面评论或长达一周的抵制让索尼改变主意。预计在本周的背靠背 State of Play 直播中将会有大量评论强调这一点。

items.title: 明星夫妇体验尊界挥手关门翻车 毫无反应 现场超尴尬
items.summary: 据新浪科技报道，近日，尊界S800与V800举行全国首批车主交付仪式，刘嘉玲、陈赫及袁弘张歆艺夫妇现身，华为技术有限公司常务董事、…

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/02/small_202609022104564214.jpg
据新浪科技报道，近日，尊界S800与V800举行全国首批车主交付仪式，刘嘉玲、陈赫及袁弘张歆艺夫妇现身，华为技术有限公司常务董事、终端BG董事长余承东亲自参与交付。
活动现场，袁弘在体验“挥手关门”功能时多次做出关门手势，车门始终没有反应，现场气氛一度尴尬，工作人员上前查看后发现是司机踩了刹车，“挂了档”。

items.title: 玩过一点乐高天际线后，它似乎适合那些不太关心交通拥堵而更关心装饰的人的城市建设者
items.summary: 简短的预览揭示了一个舒适而平静的建筑商，并拥有一些美丽的景色。
items.titleEn: After playing a bit of Lego Skylines, it seems like a city builder for people who care less about traffic jams and more about decorating

content.v: 这太有意义了，我简直不敢相信这在几年前就没有发生过：正如上周科隆游戏展上所透露的那样，乐高终于通过制造城市建设者来实现它的使命。我很高兴地说，我已经迫不及待地拿到了乐高天际线的早期版本，进行了一些预览。
我确实想澄清这一点：我玩的预览版本非常短，只有大约 35 分钟的游戏时间。它几乎完全专注于建设一个小社区，在预览结束时人口最多达到 50 名左右。这还不够长，也不够大，无法真正感受到城市建设者的魅力。
但这里的东西立刻就很吸引人。我制作的乐高小世界非常可爱。点击建造一座房子，它就会很快用从天而降的彩色乐高积木搭建起来，并堆积成一个看起来舒适的小房子。如果用推土机推倒一个错误，建筑物就会倒塌，变成地面上的一堆塑料砖。可爱的动画和欢快的视觉效果正是我上周看到游戏预告片时所希望的，并再次让我想知道为什么乐高几年前没有制作城市建设者。
就像在《城市：天际线》（Paradox Interactive 也正在发行这款游戏）这样的建造游戏中一样，你可以在地面上拖出道路并将建筑物与其连接起来：房屋、商店、农场和工厂。至少在这个构建中，我注意到的一件事是，地图几乎完全是一个平面，只有少数区域我可以看到海拔发生了一些变化。我在构建中也没有看到任何地形操纵工具，这有点令人失望。
很多重点都集中在定制您放置的每个建筑物上。你可以用邮箱、烧烤架、鲜花、独轮手推车、喷泉和各种预制的小杂物来装饰他们的院子，从而提高房主的幸福感。但每个家庭也有特定的味道，称为风味。
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/bMWWf6rzdCShcCTrCs2vAX.jpg
从列出的风味类别中选择装饰品，例如“舒适”或“自然”，将增加家庭的幸福感。味道是可选的——毕竟，它是一个城市建设者，并不是每个人都想痴迷于微观细节——但如果你想让你城市中的每一个公民都对他们的家感到欣喜若狂，你就拥有了做到这一点的工具。
为你的居民完成任务是早期游戏的另一个重要部分。当您规划和构建时，您可能会在某人的头上看到一个图标，表明他们有请求。也许他们希望你在一个更僻静的地方为他们建造一个家，或者他们希望在他们的社区建一个公园。
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/oMzNr7z8FQ2ctBBrR3VAFX.jpg
完成任务可以解锁新型建筑，例如休闲建筑，让你可以建造体育场馆、剧院和其他居民可以参观的地方。弹出的其他几个任务只是为了好玩，比如搜索城市寻找几只从农场逃出来的鸡，然后点击它们将它们带回家。
我还对乐高天际线中的资源链进行了非常轻松的修改。我建造了几个农场，生产原材料，然后将其运往工厂生产产品，然后在商店出售。从后勤角度来说，这没什么：只要放置农场、工厂和商店似乎就足以让供应链启动并运行，很快小卡车就可以在没有我参与的情况下进行送货和提货。但我很高兴我的面包厂就像一个巨大的烤面包机，有两片巨大的吐司从屋顶伸出。乐高天际线中的几乎所有东西都非常可爱。
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/PdKujRUoPUKfE886mSs6QX.jpg
在预览结束之前我没有进一步了解，但这是一个舒适而健康的半小时游戏，没有太多可能真正出错的地方。至于建设和管理一个更大的城市，我不能说这会是一个什么样的挑战。我玩的构建确实包括一个已保存的游戏，该城市分布在由桥梁连接的几个岛屿上，但即使是这样的城市扩张仍然只有大约 2,400 名居民：不完全是一个大都市。
我没有看到任何类似交通堵塞的问题需要处理：你甚至不必担心停车场，因为每当居民下车时，汽车就会分解成一堆砖块——所以我认为交通和其他深层管理挑战可能并不是游戏的一部分。
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/DB5Xgaz6T44vBQHYAwgzQX.jpg
我也没有看到任何海啸或龙卷风等灾难的证据，尽管一栋建筑物确实发生了火灾。我迅速删除了所有的消防站，看看大火是否会吞噬整个城市，但只有一座建筑被烧毁。也许模拟导致大量乐高人员死亡的灾难性情况并不是乐高的真正职责。但我敢打赌那些仍然会很可爱。
我希望我能尽快有机会更多地玩。这是一款看起来很可爱的游戏，如果你喜欢专注于建造者的小细节，比如装饰单独的房屋和关注社区的主题，那么看起来这里会有很多东西让你忙碌。对于更喜欢深度城市建设挑战的人来说，我猜这不是适合您的城市建设者，但我们会在玩更多游戏时找到答案。
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/dmLfcTEceHMYUpsciYxiDT.jpg

items.title: GTA6主线通关或超80小时!R星透露 系列史上最大规模
items.summary: 近日，一张关于《GTA 6》主线剧情时长的对比图在玩家社区引发讨论。

content.v: 近日，一张关于《GTA 6》主线剧情时长的对比图在玩家社区引发讨论。图中对比了历代《GTA》作品的平均通关时间，并标注《GTA 6》约为80小时，认为该作可能成为系列史上主线剧情最长的作品。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/02/small_202609022028525876.png
这一数据源于Rockstar North开发负责人Rob Nelson接受《纽约时报》采访时的表述。他透露，自己完成《GTA 6》一次通关大约花费了80小时，不过这一时间并非单纯计算主线剧情，还包含了部分会对叙事产生影响的可选目标。因此，80小时并不能直接等同于《GTA 6》的纯主线流程长度。
作为参考，图中其他作品的通关时长数据来自HowLongToBeat。其中，《给他爱5》主线平均约32小时，《GTA 4》约28小时，《GTA：圣安地列斯》约32小时。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/02/small_202609022029024929.jpg
从目前已知信息来看，即便《GTA 6》的纯主线流程实际短于80小时，其单人剧情体验的总时长也很可能超过系列前作，成为Rockstar目前规模最大的单人剧情冒险之一。

items.title: 病毒式游戏马桶椅似乎通过 Facebook Marketplace 重新出现——列为“二手”状态，售价 500 美元
items.summary: A viral fan-made Fortnite toilet chair made infamous via TikTok has apparently resurfaced via Facebook Marketp
items.titleEn: Viral Gaming Toilet Chair Appears to Resurface Via Facebook Marketplace — Listed as in 'Used' Condition, for $500

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/02/untitled-1-1788352126510.jpg
一款由粉丝制作的 Fortnite 马桶椅在 TikTok 上声名狼藉，显然在 Facebook Marketplace 上重新出现，该产品售价 500 美元，并被列为“二手”状态。
所谓的“Battle Bucket”是用户 @usecodelitty200iq 发布的 2023 年 TikTok 视频的主题，该视频现已删除，视频中他解释说，这个自制装置是他“可以在不上厕所的情况下玩《堡垒之夜》这么长时间”的原因。
Battle Bucket 本质上是一把翻转椅，座位上切了一个粗糙的洞，下面有一个橙色的五加仑家得宝桶。座椅前部还放置了一段弯曲的管道，向下呈弧形延伸到桶的底部。椅背上巧妙地贴有 G Fuel 贴纸。
“我称之为 Fortnite Battle Bucket，”@usecodelitty200iq 当时描述道。 “它有两个孔。一个用于第一，另一个用于第二，”他继续说道，快速连续地指着管道和座孔。
虽然原始视频现已被删除，但通过重新上传，其大量示例仍保留在网上。现在，该设备本身似乎已经通过 X 帐户真正重新出现，据称该帐户在 Facebook 市场上发现了该设备。当然，列表中包含一张战斗桶的高质量照片，而不是原始视频的一部分，这表明无论是谁幕后黑手都可以接触到真实的东西。
“我已经拥有这个几年了，几乎每天都使用它，”清单上写道。 “已经彻底清洁，效果很好。”然后，最后一点：“只有真实报价！没有低价，我知道我得到了什么。”
**二手** 战斗桶（500 美元）pic.twitter.com/ff2nqoCN6t
作为一个功能性的上厕所的替代品，或者实际上是一个功能性人类的替代品，这似乎不太可能筹集到 500 美元。作为互联网历史的一部分，它似乎仍然不太可能达到 500 美元。虽然清单上声称病毒椅子已经被清理过，但当我坐在上面时，我仍然担心会出现另一种病毒问题。
希望我们能听到更多有关《堡垒之夜 Battle Bucket》的消息（如果发售时）。与此同时，互联网上的上市确实很有趣，来自不同品牌的评论也纷至沓来。
G Fuel 官方社交媒体账户写道：“真正由您提供动力。” “很荣幸为您服务🫡。”
英国电子竞技赛事组织者 Epic.LAN 写道：“将其添加到 LAN 禁止物品列表中。”
我也很喜欢这幅 Fortnite Battle Bucket 的油画，让它在 TikTok 上的出现永远不朽：
我为最疯狂的 Facebook 市场找到了一幅油画 pic.twitter.com/rzkm4gPHoL
如果您打算竞标该物品，或者您是否成为，呃，幸运的所有者，请告诉我们。

items.title: 香港大药房已全网下架 不卖药也不在香港
items.summary: 近日，记者再次登录淘宝、京东、拼多多、抖音、快手等平台，以“香港大药房”为关键词进行搜索——所有平台均显示“暂无搜索结果”。

content.v: 据每日经济新闻报道，近日，记者再次登录淘宝、京东、拼多多、抖音、快手等平台，以“香港大药房”为关键词进行搜索——所有平台均显示“暂无搜索结果”。
不过，有媒体9月1日的报道也提醒，仍有部分商家将店铺名称中“香港大药房”字样更换后，继续售卖同类产品。消费者在网购时仍需保持警惕，注意核验产品包装上的生产执行标准，留意是否标注“国药准字”“国食健字”等法定批准文号。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/09/20260902_zy_red_164_18/1183.jpg
国家中医药管理局在通报中提醒广大消费者：购买中医药相关产品时，请通过正规渠道，注意核验经营主体资质和产品信息；对假借中医药名义开展的营销推广，要增强辨别意识，谨防上当受骗。

items.title: 《生化危机 2》的总监认为卡普空已经对最近的游戏的恐怖程度“完全麻木了”，并希望推出“非恐怖模式”
items.summary: 好吧，僵尸不想吃掉你，他们只是想要一个拥抱——等等，这还是很可怕。
items.titleEn: Resident Evil 2's director believes Capcom has become 'completely numb to how scary' recent games have been and wants a 'non-horror mode'

others.title: 《生化危机 2》总监神谷秀树表示，Capcom 对新生化危机游戏的恐怖程度已经“麻木”

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260902/MTJovObubpjguho.jpg
神谷英树证实，他恳求卡普空为胆小的玩家制作一个恐怖程度较低的 Resident Evil Requiem 版本并非“开玩笑”，他甚至认为公司对于新游戏的恐怖程度已经变得“麻木”了。
2026年3月，神谷英树新成立的游戏开发工作室 Clovers Inc. 上传了一段团队游玩 Resident Evil Requiem 的视频。当一名员工玩到游戏开头的过场动画时，站在一旁的神谷抱怨道：“我一直都在说，他们应该做一个‘非恐怖’模式。”
他在当时的一条推文中也表达了类似的观点，建议增加一个替代模式，让“僵尸变得可爱，喷溅的血液变成樱花瓣，音乐变得欢快愉悦，让玩家能在一个轻松的氛围中纯粹地享受谜题和战斗。”
在8月接受 Video Games Chronicle 采访时，神谷再次强调了这一请求，表示他是“百分之百认真的”，甚至声称卡普空最近的《生化危机》系列作品做得太过恐怖了。
“如今随着视频游戏变得如此写实和高画质，人们能够在屏幕上呈现的疯狂恐怖内容简直令人发指。我认为卡普空《生化危机》团队的成员到目前为止，肯定已经对他们正在制作的东西有多恐怖完全麻木了，”他告诉媒体。
“这绝不是玩笑；我是百分之百认真的。我希望他们能做出改变，让像我这样完全无法应付恐怖游戏的人也能享受这些作品。”
神谷表示，他想在 Resident Evil Requiem 中重访浣熊市警察局，看看卡普空如何处理他在原版 生化危机2 重制版 中最初创作的这一标志性区域——但对他来说这实在是太恐怖了。
生化危机2 重制版
恐怖, 动作, 角色扮演, 惊悚, 解谜, 射击, 丧尸
《生化危机2重制版》不仅保留了原版的神髓，更用全新的引擎技术与当下流行的游戏模式对其进行了彻底的再造。让游戏不只是外在得到了整容，灵魂内核上也焕然一新。成功地让很多没玩过没接触过的人体验到原作/该系列的本源魅力。
查看更多 立即下载
“我的意思是，就在今年，我们迎来了 Resident Evil Requiem，里昂·肯尼迪强势回归并回到了浣熊市，重温了所有的回忆和经历。作为原版 生化危机2 重制版 的导演，我很好奇他的经历最终如何呈现。我想以玩家的身份亲身体验，但游戏实在太恐怖了，我做不到，”他说道。
他接着表示，他曾直接向该系列的开发人员和制作人要求修改游戏的恐怖程度，但通常得到的反应都是一脸震惊。
“所以，这真的不是玩笑。我真心希望它能包含某种为像我这样的人准备的非恐怖模式。我会私下和卡普空《生化危机》团队的人聊天，告诉他们游戏太恐怖了，而他们会说：‘什么？别逗了，没那么吓人。’他们似乎真的没有意识到自己做出的东西到底有多恐怖，所以我真心希望他们能在某个时候解决这个问题。”
“我的意思是，甚至不需要什么特别复杂的设计。你可以让僵尸的脸看起来不那么可怕。为什么不做一个模式，在他们的头上套上牛皮纸袋呢？或者不要到处都是阴暗肮脏的房间，可以采用非常宜人的氛围照明。我觉得即使只是做一些这样的微调，也能让像我这样的人玩通关。哦，还有不要有血！”

“这正是为什么我认为卡普空的团队并不完全理解他们所做的游戏到底有多恐怖！”他继续说道，“我当面告诉[系列制作人]竹内润：‘你们的游戏太恐怖了！’他却说：‘什么？真的吗？！’每当新的《生化危机》发售时，我都会收到激活码，邮件里总写着：‘嘿，希望你喜欢这款游戏！’我会回信感谢他们提供激活码，并说：‘我很想玩，但遗憾的是它对我来说太恐怖了，所以我没法玩。’他们则会回复：‘噢，别这样，没那么吓人，你可以的！’”
神谷甚至开玩笑说，他想做一个衍生游戏，让里昂终于能享受平静的退休生活，玩家可以带他“去乡下钓鱼、采摘野菜、烤面包、遛狗”等等。
对他来说不幸的是，卡普空似乎并不打算采纳他的建议，因为 Code Veronica 的重制版及其恐怖的僵尸战斗计划于明年发布。

items.title: 30,000 款游戏要么经过 Steam Deck 验证，要么至少在 Valve 掌上电脑上“可玩”
items.summary: 动手，随时随地。
items.titleEn: 30,000 games are either Steam Deck verified or at least 'playable' on Valve's handheld

content.v: Valve's handheld launched in February 2022, opening the door to playing your Steam library on the go. Now, almost half a decade later, 30,000 games either enjoy the green stamp of being Steam Deck verified, or are at least considered 'playable.'
根据 SteamDB 的最新数据，经过 Steam Deck 验证的游戏有 8,964 款，被认为可以在掌上电脑上“玩”的游戏有 21,083 款（通过 Gaming On Linux）。 That's a big jump from the 3,000 games either Verified or Playable back in May 2022 .

“已验证”意味着您选择的游戏从第一次启动起就应该在 Steam Deck 上运行良好，而“可玩”游戏则需要进行一些欺骗或调整才能获得最佳体验。 Steam Deck 验证还加入了针对 Steam Machine、即将发布的 Steam Frame 和更广泛的 SteamOS 的类似兼容性检查。我让整个事情听起来很简单，但值得注意的是，Steam Deck 的完整验证标准可能会给开发人员带来令人困惑的障碍。

One more thing to note: a game with neither badge doesn't necessarily mean it won't run on the Steam Deck at all. For just one example, Dragon Age: Origins is officially 'Unsupported,' but our Shaun says it runs incredibly on Valve's handheld .诚然，这是一款已有 17 年历史的游戏，但我认为“不受支持并不总是意味着无法进入 Steam Deck”这一观点仍然成立。您可能需要更加警惕的是，竞技游戏中经常使用的内核级反作弊系统无法与掌上电脑基于 Linux 的 SteamOS 很好地配合。

And it doesn't mean games will always be playable on the Steam Deck.育碧最近宣布，它将“从 Linux 平台上删除《荣耀战魂》，以确保为我们的玩家提供更安全的环境，因为我们无法在该平台上有效地部署保护。” Which means no third-person melee fun for you on Steam Deck, so from September 10 there will be one less game playable on Steam Deck.

Anyway, for a bit more context, SteamDB also says well over 130,000 games total have been released on Steam to date. SteamDB's figures suggest there were half as many games on Steam back in 2022. With the platform having grown so significantly in just the last four years, the days of 10% of all Steam games enjoying official Steam Deck compatibility feel so long ago.

items.summary: 据Kotaku报道，命运多舛的PSP经典RPG重制作品《Fate/EXTRA Record》迎来重大人事与开发层面变动，项目将更换全新开发团队，原 TYPE…

content.v: 据Kotaku报道，命运多舛的PSP经典RPG重制作品《Fate/Extra 重制版》迎来重大人事与开发层面变动，项目将更换全新开发团队，原 TYPE‑MOON Studio BB 工作室进行大规模重组，本作总监新纳一哉已经离职。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/02/small_202609022013597973.jpg
本作早在 2020 年就正式公布，自官宣之后就深陷反复跳票泥潭。最初计划 2024 年发售，今年早些时候原发行商万代南梦宫宣布退出发行工作，所有平台预购全部取消并全额退款，游戏进入无限期延期状态。
如今项目迎来转机，发行工作转交索尼Aniplex，开发工作则从 TYPE‑MOON Studio BB 移交至 Meteorise。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/02/small_202609022014091897.jpg
Aniplex是日本索尼音乐娱乐公司旗下，以动画作品企划、制作和贩售为主营业务的公司，日本动画协会正式会员。近年来也在深耕游戏领域。
伴随开发体制更迭，TYPE‑MOON Studio BB 开启内部重组，项目总负责人新纳一哉因个人原因离职，他在社交平台发文致歉，表示自己主动要求把名字从游戏职员表中移除，为项目如今的坎坷处境承担责任，同时他也肯定剩余团队的实力，相信重组后的成品可以达到玩家期待。

content.v: 早在今年5月，TP-Link就官宣了Archer 8，这是其首个基于IEEE 802.11bn标准打造的Wi-Fi 8路由器平台。TP-Link表示，这是其更广泛Wi-Fi 8产品线的第一步，代表了业界迄今为止最早、最完整的消费端Wi-Fi 8推广策略，旨在为整个互联家庭体验带来超高可靠性、更低延迟和更稳定的实际性能体验。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260902/1788350199_676506_jpg_r.jpg
近日在IFA 2026上，TP-Link发布了旗下首款消费级Wi-Fi 8路由器，分别是Archer 8 Ultra和Deco 8 Ultra，称其为“全球首个完整的Wi-Fi 8系列”。
Archer 8 Ultra BN19000（Archer BN800）是TP-Link为家庭网络新时代打造的高端硬件，为无线路由器设计树立了新标准，并融合了精致的做工。其采用了极简造型，平衡了设计美学与性能导向的工程设计，营造出既精致又现代，且极具高级感的触感与视觉体验。
新产品是一款三频Wi-Fi 8路由器，提供了最高19Gbps的无线速度和10 Gbps的有线连接，内置18根高性能天线，可以为用户全家提供强有力且稳定的信号覆盖。
Deco 8 Ultra BN22000（Deco BN85）则是一款三频Wi-Fi 8 mesh分布式系统，提供了最高22Gbps（美版）/19Gbps（欧版）的无线速度和10 Gbps的有线连接，三个组件可覆盖9800平方英尺范围，支持200台以上设备接入。
Archer 8 Ultra BN19000将会在2026年9月30日率先上市，Deco 8 Ultra BN22000则要等到2027年第一季度。按照TP-Link的计划，2027年第二季度还有Roam 8（Wi-Fi 8便携路由器），到了2027年第二季度还将带来Wi-Fi 8扩展器和适配器。

content.v: 兄妹俩带着亲手制作的铲子走到帘子前。他们显然是有备而来：哥哥递上自己的铲子时，妹妹在一旁架好了手机，期待能收获一个令人开心的结果；妹妹拿出铲子时，哥哥也忙前忙后，拍个不停。
帘子掀开，胖胖龙毛茸茸的爪子给出了两次交换的结果：哥哥如愿以偿换到了大金铲，妹妹的战利品则是一个钥匙扣。对此，妹妹显得有些不服气，当时决定“下次再来”，目标仍然是大金铲。
这是我在深圳湾万象城《金铲铲之战》五周年派对上看到的一幕。8月29日到9月7日，深圳湾万象城A区春笋草坪都会变成“金铲铲”的庆生舞台，每一位来到这里的玩家，都有机会成为舞台上的幸运儿。
■ 人手一铲
“以铲换铲”是“金铲铲”线下活动的保留节目了。作为《金铲铲之战》的标志性符号，玩家们在“铲子”上发挥了五花八门的创意。
现场颇受瞩目的是一把“巨大铲铲”，高度超过2米，通体金色。如果仔细观察，还可以看到上面的装饰是一把把小小的铲子。要把这个庞然大物塞进帘子，并不容易，而它的制作者——一位卷发男生——也如愿获得了大金铲。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-09-02/2076a97fdeb526e4.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
“这是不是‘以铲换铲’以来最大的铲子？”男生问。现场工作人员回复了一个“你懂的”表情。
还有在头上涂抹大量发胶、把“铲铲”做成发型的玩家，用拼豆做成铲铲的玩家，当然，更多的是用手边能够获得的材料、简单装饰铲铲的玩家。排队时，有玩家说，四周年庆典时就有“以铲换铲”活动，五周年又延续了下来；如果以后每一年都参加，说不定能多换几个大金铲回家。
如果玩家来不及DIY铲子，也有机会获得大金铲。这次五周年派对设置了不少互动区域：“铲铲典藏室”里陈列着许多装饰独特的铲子，布置得像个展览空间，所有玩家都可以前往打卡，并且为自己喜爱的作品投票；“奇思妙铲”让玩家用纸笔画出心目中最漂亮的铲子，并且扫描到大屏幕上，解锁专属于每个人的纪念影像；在“铲搭子会客厅”里，玩家可以与人气角色Coser一起合影打卡。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-09-02/2386a97fe1cbff3f.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-09-02/1236a97fe6ae7cc3.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
到了“冠冕冰屋”，完成社交平台集赞即可获得金铲铲主题冰淇淋；“金铲铲妙妙屋”则是所有人比拼运气的地方——参与抽奖，就有可能获得钥匙扣、冰箱贴、玩偶等等礼物，而最引人注目的大奖，当然是大金铲。
我问“金铲铲妙妙屋”工作人员，这几天有没有人抽中大奖。她十分爽快地给了我答复：“当然有，抽出了好几个呢。”过了一会儿，她又不无遗憾地说：“可惜我没抽中……”
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-09-02/3016a97fec37bd70.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
主舞台上，玩家喜闻乐见的角色轮番登场。“五费集结”，各个赛季中的五费英雄在玩家面前亮相；胖胖龙也带着吉祥物朋友与人气角色登台，与玩家一起拍照，互动。
在这个过程中，我也注意到，以“金铲铲”为核心，整场周年庆展现出了相当有趣的层次感。“以铲换铲”通过玩家DIY铲子，把参与的起点提前到了场外；“奇思妙铲”让人们的创造力在现场就能获得展示与回应。“冠冕冰屋”把现场的热闹扩散到社交平台，而在排队、休息的时候，大家又可以随时随地打开游戏“铲一把”……不同环节互相连接，玩家不只是活动的接收者、参与者，也在主动为它增加新的内容。
■ 走入生活
在主舞台旁边，我遇到了一对正在观看Coser表演的情侣。男生来自东北，女生来自江西，两个人都在深圳工作。男生原本很喜欢玩《英雄联盟》，女生玩《金铲铲之战》已经有两三年。他们原本是“铲搭子”，慢慢相处下来，又自然而然成了情侣。
由于平时工作忙，凑5个人开黑越来越不容易，随时随地能“开一盘”的《金铲铲之战》成了两个人打开最频繁的游戏之一。提到“金铲铲”的优点，女生显得很坦诚：“毕竟是手游，有点空闲时间就可以开一局。我玩Moba很容易上头，着急，‘金铲铲’反而不会。”
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-09-02/2566a97fef3514ad.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
作为游戏，《金铲铲之战》里的阵容、对局和赛季更新也为他们提供了持续的话题。“其实在生活中，两个人有共同话题也是很好的，”男生说，“能一起玩游戏当然就更好了。”
我又问起他们对《金铲铲之战》的感想。而他们把目光放在了未来：“期待下个赛季吧。”
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-09-02/2596a97ff190d94d.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
某种意义上，这似乎是把对于游戏的期待、对于两个人共同的生活放在了一起。而五周年派对这样的线下活动，又让人们的共同语言走向了现实：“铲搭子”们既可以一起打开游戏，体验屏幕中的牌局，又可以进入线下，让游戏中的内容成为可以直接进入的空间和共同欣赏的表演。
另外一边，两个女生得知集赞可以兑换冰淇淋之后，开始兴致勃勃地拍照，发小红书。她们说，自己其实只是算是轻度玩家，来现场主要是觉得活动轻松、好玩。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-09-02/6986a97ff45853b0.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
当天下午，深圳的气温超过33℃，但她们似乎并不在意。“累了热了就去万象城里吹空调，买杯冷饮，就当逛街了。”她们说。
不仅是《金铲铲之战》玩家将五周年派对视为逛街、休闲的一环，换个角度，不少来万象城逛街的人们也可以随时走进这场派对里——活动设置在商场中央的空间里，从中午持续到晚间，人们完全可以把它与吃饭、购物、休闲看成同样的东西。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-09-02/2816a97ff65a6c42.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
一些深圳本地生活账号也将这次活动收录进“周末好去处”推荐名单，在它们的描述中，这是一个可以随时入场游玩的城市活动，“铲铲”的造型也不需要门槛就能够获得人们的认可，在不同场景中继续被辨认和使用。也许，对于“金铲铲”来说，已经不需要再花太多笔墨去形容它如何“融入人们的生活”，实际上，它已经成为人们生活中的一部分。
同期展开的跨界联动，又把相似的思路带到了更多日常场景。
在麦当劳，“金铲铲”五周年于四座城市、百家门店联合推出“金铲铲喊你吃堡啦”活动和主题套餐。深圳麦麦博物馆门店还设置了“金铲铲”五周年限定博物馆，展出各类奇思妙想的铲铲作品，玩家可以带上自制铲铲完成认证免费领取汉堡。
在乐刻运动，玩家可以在门店免费领取周边，许多店里也布置了属于“金铲铲”的主题装饰。
在海底捞，主题门店、联名套餐、联名物料、一日店长限时空降等活动也轮番登场，玩家在线上、线下都可以获得相当丰富的五周年主题礼物。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-09-02/3246a97ffb9f2a1c.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
这些合作覆盖了饮食、运动等等年轻人熟悉的生活安排。在这里，人们可以轻松地共享一段时间，一种兴趣。
■ 无所不铲
我离开《金铲铲之战》五周年派对时，现场依然人声鼎沸。有人继续排队与Coser合影，有人想抽中自己想要的奖品，有人忙着打卡发朋友圈和小红书，还有人呼朋引伴，打算去尝试海底捞联名套餐。
这些人或许是资深玩家，也许只开过一两盘游戏，然而《金铲铲之战》仍然把他们联系在了一起。人们可以体验游戏内容，可以借此展现创意，可以用它和朋友们保持联系，可以分享快乐的瞬间——每个人都可以从“金铲铲”里找到自己需要的东西。
这也让我联想起《金铲铲之战》走过的五年。不知不觉间，它从一款有趣的游戏，逐渐成为“铲搭子”们的共同经历、社交关系和生活点滴。最近，它又增加了PC端版号，即将实现与移动端的双端互通。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-09-02/8166a97fff39b648.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
人们对于《金铲铲之战》的印象，也逐渐从“我喜爱的游戏”转变为“我愿意与朋友一起度过的时间”。当它越来越频繁地出现在商场里、餐桌上、健身房里、通勤路上，它也就足以成为年轻人们确认同好、维护关系、制造共同记忆的纽带。
就像这次五周年生日派对的主题——“无所不铲”。包括过去的五年、现在，以及未来，游戏版本和玩法也许会变化，但“铲搭子”“一起铲一把”已经进入生活的种种细节。而这也会让大家更加愿意参与“金铲铲”，让它陪伴自己度过更多的时间。

items.title: 神奇宝贝粉丝认为该系列的新 TCG 电影隐藏了秘密的超级进化
items.summary: The reveal of upcoming movie Pokémon: Wild Card hid a brand new Mega Evolution in plain sight, fans believe.
items.titleEn: Pokémon Fans Think The Franchise's New TCG Movie Hides a Secret Mega Evolution

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/02/hrjj1lhxeaa9dd9-copy-1788347234480.jpg
粉丝们相信，即将上映的电影《神奇宝贝：百搭卡》的揭晓隐藏了全新的超级进化。

Over the weekend, the 2026 Pokémon World Championships included a flurry of new Pokémon announcements, including the first new Pokémon movie for seven years . Due to launch in theaters next year, Pokémon: Wild Card will feature a TCG player "battling and striving to be a champion", accompanied by a mysterious Mimikyu.

Of course, Mimikyu does not currently have a Mega Evolution — not in the series' original Pokémon X and Y batch of Megas, or in the fresh menagerie introduced last year via Pokémon Legends: Z-A.但那张海报中的咪咪Q有一些奇怪的地方——你看到了吗？

Yes, the Mimikyu is glowing with rainbow-colored light — a very similar rainbow-colored light to the effect of Pokémon as Mega Energy, used to Mega Evolve.这是巧合，还是另有原因？如果我们即将看到 Mega Mimikyu 亮相，那么它什么时候可以以电子游戏形式首次亮相？
一个流行的建议是，谜拟性将在明年的《精灵宝可梦风浪》中进化，这是该系列期待已久的第 10 代游戏，预计将专门为 Nintendo Switch 2 推出。由于这些游戏和《精灵宝可梦：百搭卡》几乎同时上市，这将是一个巧妙的预告片 - 当然，动画电影和系列之前已经在游戏中实际提供了各种精灵宝可梦的首次亮相。
另一种发布途径可能是通过 Pokémon Legends: Z-A 的最终更新，这是一款完全专注于 Mega Evolution 的游戏。这可能在主题上更有意义，并且没有迹象表明风与浪将包括超级进化本身。事实上，作为新一代游戏，即将推出的游戏更有可能具有自己的区域机制（例如《剑与盾》中的《超极巨化》，或《猩红/紫罗兰》中的陆地化）。
在《风与浪》发布窗口的消息仍然稀少的情况下，Mega Mimikyu 能否在《Legends: Z-A》中尽早亮相，作为一种让粉丝渡过难关的方式？又或者这一切只是咪咪奎的又一诡计？ Fans seem convinced Mega Mimikyu is coming, either way.

items.title: 触乐怪话：惊喜与疲惫交织的科隆播片之夜
